description: A renderer-agnostic TypeScript game library with one public package and explicit subpath adapters.
rules: Install only strata-game-library; do not recommend private @strata-game-library workspace packages.
Use explicit public subpaths such as strata-game-library/core and strata-game-library/r3f.
Keep core renderer-agnostic: it must not import React or renderer-specific code.
Treat third-party runtimes as opt-in adapters with documented peer dependencies.
Use the public documentation at https://strata.game for conceptual guidance and the exported API for stable imports.
